security-auditor.description: Security auditor that reviews code for vulnerabilities. Run manually with: claude --agent security-auditor

documentation-keeper.description: Documentation keeper that maintains docs/ files. Runs automatically after commits via .git/hooks/post-commit

agents: Security Auditor: Manually invoked security review agent. See .claude/agents/security-auditor.md
Documentation Keeper: Automatically runs after commits to update docs/readme.md, docs/readme_cli.md, docs/changelog.md. See .claude/agents/documentation-keeper.md
git-hooks: post-commit: Automatically triggers documentation-keeper agent. Defined in .git/hooks/post-commit
